The script builds with 'npm --prefix $ROOT run build -w site' (astro build only). That skips the root prebuild (scripts/katex-assets.mjs, names.mjs, presets.mjs), so on a clean checkout with npm ci done the mutant build fails before any test runs. Supplementary run, not part of the verdict: after the root npm run build done for findings 01 to 05, the same script printed 'T13-keyboard.spec.ts ... 3 passed (16.1s)' against the mutant. The paint-focus spec then failed with 'Error: after Enter painted node 1 black ... Expected: "decoration:1" Received: "BODY"'. On the unchanged gate build the paint-focus spec gave '1 passed'. verdicts.reason: needs undocumented step: the root prebuild (npm run build, or node scripts/names.mjs and the other prebuild scripts) before the script.
